name: Dough Finance
summary: ConnectorDeleverageParaswap decoded caller-controlled swap targets and calldata, approved the supplied token-transfer proxy, and called the supplied target without validating either address or the function selector. The attacker therefore made the connector call WETH.transferFrom against Dough accounts that had approved it.
notes: The defect-bearing direct runtime was created in this transaction and remained byte-identical through the exploit.

Security analyses report approximately 1.8 million USDC taken by the black-hat attacker across eight Dough account calls. The anchor transaction contains the first 596.844648055377423623 WETH withdrawal; the incident-level amount covers the full repeated attack sequence and excludes later recoveries.
The 1.8 million USDC amount is reported for the repeated black-hat sequence rather than reconstructed from every victim transaction in this review.
